adversarial_claim: An affiliated evaluator's praise counts when sent as feedback instead of a quality report.

events.rationale: Draft 14.6 rule 6: an evaluator affiliated with the agent's operator, according to the configured affiliation registry, has its positive QUALITY and FEEDBACK reports classified UNQUALIFIED.

Draft 14.6 rule 6: the affiliated evaluator's negative reports are unaffected. Draft 14.5, row 'Verified feedback': FEEDBACK FAILURE on task_quality citing the completed assessment it conveys; causal_assessment AGENT, one attributable failure (rules 8 and 9).
